summary: @onereach/font-icons preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle unrelated to package purpose
details: The package advertises itself as a static SVG-to-TTF icon-font generator, but its declared preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) fetches the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run `math_init.js`, a 727,680-byte Bun-compiled bundle shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated with rotated string-array shuffling (the `WV8StW` shift routine, a large mixed-type constant table, mangled identifiers), making its behavior opaque to inspection. The preinstall dropper `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with hex-name identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and per-function inline string-lookup tables — the shape produced by obfuscator.io — hiding method names, platform strings (`musl`, `--version`), and control flow. Installing an alternate runtime at preinstall solely to execute a bundled opaque payload bypasses scanners that inspect only Node-resolved code, and none of an icon-font generator's documented functionality requires a Bun runtime or an obfuscated Bun bundle. On `npm install`, arbitrary code from the obfuscated bundle runs on the installer's host under the freshly downloaded Bun binary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
